settings.label: Default social share image
settings.info: Used for link previews when a page has no image of its own.

settings.label: Browser chrome colour
settings.info: Only used for the mobile browser's own toolbar tint. Page colours come from zorev-tokens.css.

settings.content: These describe offers that Shopify actually applies through automatic discounts (Discounts). Change a discount there and change it here too, or the store will promise a price the cart won't charge. Quantity tiers live on each product, in the 'Quantity offer' metafield.

settings.label: Product A
settings.info: The product that receives the saving (the 'customer gets' side of the Buy X Get Y discount).

settings.label: Product B
settings.info: The 'customer buys' side. Shopify only applies the pair saving when the bag holds at least as many of A as of B — the cart offer follows that rule.

settings.label: Pair discount title
settings.info: Must match the automatic discount's title exactly. The cart uses it to confirm the saving really applied before it says so.

settings.content: Shopify takes the homepage title and description from Online Store > Preferences. These are used instead while those are empty or just the shop name.

settings.label: Homepage title
settings.default: ZOREV — Perfume oil and balm stick, free shipping worldwide

settings.label: Homepage meta description
settings.default: ZOREV sells two essentials: GODA, a 15 ml perfume oil worn from a dropper, and HOYGI, a 9 g balm stick that goes on dry. Multi-buy and pair savings apply in your bag. Free tracked shipping, worldwide.

settings.label: Show '30-day returns'
settings.info: Leave off until Settings > Policies > Refund policy allows unopened personal-care items back. It currently lists personal care goods as non-returnable, which covers every product in the store.
